Summary: On the fourteenth day of the first month, at evening, Israel offers the Passover lamb as the LORD commanded.
Commandment: On the fourteenth day of the first month at even, offer the Passover lamb to the LORD.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The lamb's blood on the doorposts marked the houses God passed over in Egypt; the New Testament reads the lamb as fulfilled in Christ, our Passover sacrificed for us (1 Corinthians 5:7).
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the meal is eaten in haste on the night of deliverance from Egypt, ready to depart (Exodus 12:11).
